Superloop questions

What is the cheapest Superloop NBN plan?

Everyday NBN 25/10 at $58/mo for 6 months, then $78/mo. That is $816 over the first year (checked 8 October 2026).

Does Superloop let you opt out of CGNAT?

Yes, Superloop gives customers a public IP address free on request.

Do you need to give Superloop 30 days notice to cancel?

Yes. Superloop asks for 30 days notice, so you may pay for part of a month after you switch.

Has Superloop raised its prices recently?

We haven't recorded any ongoing price rises for Superloop since 30 September 2026. Promo prices have changed; see the table above.
